category.description: Category: build, adb, emulator, ui, cache, index

taskName.description: Task name for baseline operations. Defaults to operation name.

summaryOnly.description: Return compact summary payload for logs/tasks/all detail types (ignored for errors)

previewChars.description: For summaryOnly with detailType logs/all: preview length in characters (default: 400)

nearestTo.description: Find elements nearest to this text (spatial proximity)

maxTier.description: Max fallback tier (1-5). Use 3 to stop before visual/grid payloads.

compact.description: Paginated flat list (default: true). false for full tree.

deviceSpace.description: x/y in device-space (default true). Set false only for image-space coords.

maxDimension.description: Max image dimension in pixels (default: 800). Higher = better quality, more tokens.
